subject_name:
Biên dịch tiếng Anh 1
English Translation 1
time_allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including projects preparation)
prerequisite: ENS411 & ENS421 & ENR401 & ENW401 & ENP101 & ENG301 K15 onward: Passed ERW411 & LTG202

general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 105 hours self-study (including projects preparation)
general_information.Pre-Requisite: ENS411 & ENS421 & ENR401 & ENW401 & ENP101 & ENG301 K15 onward: Passed ERW411 & LTG202
general_information.Description: This course is designed to build and develop foundational translation skills for 3rd-year English majors, equipping students to confidently translate between English and Vietnamese in both directions. I Students are expected to acquire and apply basic knowledge of theoretical aspects covering from translation methods, translating process, equivalence, and cultural issues... in their translation. By applying the basic theoretical knowledge, students are expected to be able to efficiently handle compiled jobs in a classroom hypothetical environment, maintain and develop basic English language skills in accordance with translation of 4 main types of texts (C1 standard) including: narrative texts,descriptiom texts, discussion texts, and dialogues. In response to the evolving demands of the language services industry, the course integrates the use of AI-based translation tools to help students become proficient in AI-assisted translation and post-editing.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop and tools in class and out of class ethically under the lecturer's instructions - Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain key translation theories including translation process, text analysis, language functions, text categories, text types and different translation methods.
Perform basic translation strategies in dealing with non-equivalence at word level and cultural issues so as to translate idioms, fixed expressions, dialogues. (Vietnamese-English and vice-versa).
Transfer an English text of various text types in on common topics to a natural Vietnamese text by applying an appropriate translation method
Transfer a Vietnamese text of various text types on common topics into an accurate English text by applying an appropriate translation method

Apply basic AI-assisted translation skills by consciously using machine translation tools , performing basic post-editing, evaluating AI outputs for accuracy and appropriateness, and demonstrating responsible and ethical use of AI in translation tasks (mapping with
Have a professional working attitude and have ability to work in a team.

assessments.Question Type: Part A – Manual Translation: Students translate short texts in class (150–200 words) without AI. Part B – AI Draft Translation: Use 1 AI tool to translate the same texts. Part C – Reflection Report: compare human vs AI outputs, explain major errors corrected, and discuss what AI did better/ more poorly than humans.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Human translation skills and AI critical exploration
assessments.Note: Part A: 70% Part B and C: 30%

assessments.Question Type: Part A – AI Draft Generation: Students choose 2 culturally rich texts (1 in English and the other in Vietnamese) with teacher's approval and use AI to translate them. Part B – Light cultural adaptation: Post-edit them for a specific target audience each text (e.g., American tourists, academic readers), submitting both AI's works and human's edited version. Part C – Presentation: Short oral presentation (10 minutes) of outputs and reasoning.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Human-in-the-loop editing, cultural literacy in translation and AI ethics
assessments.Note: Part A and B: 70% Part C: 30%

assessments.Question Type: Translation of texts given on the topics covered from Vietnamese in to English and vice versa

assessments.Question Type: Analysis of AI-generated translation works (1 E-V text and 1 V-E text). The analysis addresses the strengths and limitations in AI's works in terms of content transfer, lexical choices, grammatical structure choices and naturalism
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge and translation theory students obtain the delivered sessions 21-40
